COPY.description: Prepare complete matching LinkedIn/Medium copies now with a visible planned stable website backlink and resolved launch URLs. Planned links never establish publication/canonical/date. Exact current platform editors/live URLs and posting remain manual external gates; the later pair does not block initial website release.
